content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 20 Senior Resident vacancies in the Super Speciality Departments and 2 in the Broad Speciality Department, a total of 22. The vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease as per the actual requirement for patient care. Reservation will be as per Government of India guidelines issued from time to time. A candidate appointed under the PwD quota will be adjusted against the vacancy of the respective category of General/SC/ST/OBC/EWS. If reserved category candidates are not available for an advertised post, the available meritorious candidate may be given an offer of engagement for a period of 39 days at the sole discretion of the Appointing Authority.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice adds that, as per ESIC Headquarters Office Memorandum No. Z-11012/51/2022-MED-VI dated 08.12.2022, or any subsequent orders issued by the Headquarters Office, eligibility will be determined accordingly. The notice asks for an experience certificate among the documents but does not print a minimum period of experience. All candidates must have updated Medical Registration (NMC/State Medical Council) with all post MBBS/MD/MS qualification(s). A candidate without updated registration must show and submit a copy of the "Applied for document(s)" at the time of interview. If these conditions are not met, the candidate may not be interviewed, or the result will remain withheld if the expert committee allows the interview. A selected candidate must submit the updated Medical Registration Certificate before joining. The age limit for both posts is not exceeding 45 years as on the date of walk-in interview. The date of walk-in interview is also the cut-off date for educational qualifications and other eligibility criteria. EWS candidates should submit the EWS Certificate as per Annexure-I of Government of India, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions, DOPT Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res), dated 31.01.2019. The OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate should not be issued prior to 01 (One) year from the cut-off date, must be in the format applicable for appointment under the Government of India, and must be issued by an officer not below the rank of Sub-Divisional Officer or equivalent authority of the concerned State. Without a valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwD certificate in the Central Government format, a candidate will not be allowed to appear in the interview for the reserved category but can be treated as a UR candidate. Candidates should check the official notification and the NMC guidelines it refers to for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: In accordance with the latest guidelines of the National Medical Commission (NMC/MCI). If Super-specialty Senior Residents (MCh/DM/DrNB/FNB) are not available, Senior Residents from the concerned parent Broad Specialties will be considered.
In accordance with the latest guidelines of the National Medical Commission (NMC/MCI).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The tenure of the contract will be for 01 (One) year, which may be extendable up to 03 years, subject to satisfactory performance, willingness and conduct of the candidate and the requirements of the institution. The contract will be terminated on the appointment/joining of a bonded Senior Resident on the same post. The competent authority reserves the right to terminate the services at any time in the public interest, without prior notice or providing any reason. To resign, the Senior Resident must submit one-month advance notice or deposit an amount equivalent to one month's salary. Failure to do so will result in forfeiture of both the one-month salary and the security deposit and may also lead to legal proceedings. The Senior Resident shall not be entitled to claim any service benefits, including Provident Fund (PF), Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Medical Benefits, Seniority, Promotion or similar perks. Hostel accommodation/Quarters will be provided to the extent possible but cannot be claimed as a matter of right. If accommodation is availed, no HRA will be payable and the license fee and any other sum in lieu of HRA will be deducted as per rule. Any absence from work exceeding 07 (seven) days without prior approval will be considered voluntary abandonment of the engagement, resulting in automatic termination. Attendance must be recorded daily, both manually and through the Aadhaar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS), on scheduled working days. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining as Senior Resident. Instructions, circulars or policies issued from ESIC Headquarter Office, New Delhi from time to time, and other terms issued by the Competent Authority, will apply. The selected candidate must submit a Security Deposit of Rs. 20,000/- upon joining, through a Demand Draft payable to "ESI Fund A/c No. 1" at Faridabad. It will be refunded on successful completion of the contract period and submission of a "No Dues Certificate". If the selected candidate resigns within six months of joining, the security deposit will be forfeited, except in cases of unforeseen or unavoidable circumstances where relaxation may be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: document verification, then an interview, both on 27 November 2026. Document verification: candidates must first appear before the Document Verification Committee. Only those whose documents are successfully verified will be allowed to appear before the Interview Board. Interview: selection will be made on the basis of acquired academic credentials and performance in the interview, conducted by the duly constituted selection board. The interview opportunity is provisional, subject to detailed scrutiny of the eligibility criteria. The result will be published only in the Recruitments section of www.esic.gov.in , and the Offer of Appointment will be sent through e-mail only. Selected candidates must join as per the instructions in the offer of appointment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: There is no online application. Candidates attend the walk-in with the offline application form and documents. An application in any other format or an incomplete application will be summarily rejected. Candidates working in a Govt/Autonomous/Statutory institution should preferably bring an NOC from their employer; if it is not immediately available, a copy of "applied for NOC" and an undertaking must be submitted at document verification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Certificate of passing Class 10th for Date of Birth All Marks Sheets, Attempt, Degree Certificate of MBBS All Marks Sheets, Attempt, Degree Certificate of MD/MS/DNB/ Other Examination Valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwD Certificate issued in the format for appointment in Central Govt. job, wherever applicable State/NMC Medical Registration Certificate (updated) Experience Certificate Recent Passport Size Photograph of Candidate Relieving/NOC Certificate from previous/current Employer, if applicable Aadhaar Card All these documents will be verified with the originals. If any applicable document is not verified by the Document Verification Committee, the candidate will not be allowed in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 22 Senior Resident vacancies: 20 in seven super speciality departments and 2 in Reproductive Medicine (broad speciality). The vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. When is the ESIC Faridabad Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Document verification and the interview are on 27 November 2026, with reporting from 9 AM to 10 AM at the Examination Hall, Academic Block, ESIC Medical College & Hospital Faridabad.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for ESIC Faridabad Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The qualification is in accordance with the latest National Medical Commission (NMC/MCI) guidelines, with updated NMC/State Medical Council registration. For super speciality departments, if MCh/DM/DrNB/FNB Senior Residents are not available, Senior Residents from the concerned parent broad specialties will be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ESIC Faridabad Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 45 years as on the date of walk-in interview, 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at ESIC Faridabad?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay equals Rs. 1,50,294/- as on the date of advertisement. If hostel accommodation or quarters are availed, no HRA is payable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500/- for all other categories and Nil for SC/ST/ESIC (Regular Employee)/Female Candidate and PH Candidate, paid by Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No.- 1" payable at Faridabad.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Bring the completed offline application form attached with the advertisement, self-attested copies of documents, the checklist and originals to the walk-in on 27 November 2026 between 9 AM and 10 AM.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates first face document verification, and only those whose documents are verified appear before the Interview Board. Selection is based on academic credentials and interview performance.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ESIC Faridabad Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract of 01 (One) year that may be extendable up to 03 years, with no claim to PF, Pension, Gratuity, Seniority or Promotion.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one department?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates may apply for multiple posts if eligible for each, but a separate application with documents and fee must be submitted for each post.
